framework: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics
subject: Math
textFidelity: Standard codes are verbatim. Standard text is faithful to the published standards; longer standards are abridged to their leading clause for display in a mastery map. Verify against the source URL before any public-facing use.
note: High school standards are published by conceptual category rather than grade level. They are assigned here to the course that conventionally covers them, per the course model in docs/supernova-data-structures-addendum.md. Standards marked (+) in CCSS are beyond the college-ready threshold and are assigned to Pre-Calculus.

standards.cluster: Know number names and the count sequence
standards.text: Count to 100 by ones and by tens.

standards.cluster: Count to tell the number of objects
standards.text: Understand the relationship between numbers and quantities; connect counting to cardinality.

standards.cluster: Compare numbers
standards.text: Identify whether the number of objects in one group is greater than, less than, or equal to the number of objects in another group.

standards.cluster: Understand addition and subtraction
standards.text: Represent addition and subtraction with objects, fingers, mental images, drawings, sounds, acting out situations, verbal explanations, expressions, or equations.

standards.cluster: Understand addition and subtraction
standards.text: Fluently add and subtract within 5.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Work with numbers 11-19 to gain foundations for place value
standards.text: Compose and decompose numbers from 11 to 19 into ten ones and some further ones.

standards.cluster: Describe and compare measurable attributes
standards.text: Describe measurable attributes of objects, such as length or weight.

standards.cluster: Classify objects and count the number of objects in each category
standards.text: Classify objects into given categories; count the numbers of objects in each category and sort the categories by count.

standards.cluster: Identify and describe shapes
standards.text: Correctly name shapes regardless of their orientations or overall size.

standards.cluster: Analyze, compare, create, and compose shapes
standards.text: Analyze and compare two- and three-dimensional shapes, in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities and differences.

standards.cluster: Represent and solve problems involving addition and subtraction
standards.text: Use addition and subtraction within 20 to solve word problems involving situations of adding to, taking from, putting together, taking apart, and comparing.

standards.cluster: Understand and apply properties of operations
standards.text: Apply properties of operations as strategies to add and subtract.

standards.cluster: Add and subtract within 20
standards.text: Add and subtract within 20, demonstrating fluency for addition and subtraction within 10.

standards.cluster: Work with addition and subtraction equations
standards.text: Understand the meaning of the equal sign, and determine if equations involving addition and subtraction are true or false.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Extend the counting sequence
standards.text: Count to 120, starting at any number less than 120. Read and write numerals and represent a number of objects with a written numeral.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Understand place value
standards.text: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Use place value understanding and properties of operations to add and subtract
standards.text: Add within 100, including adding a two-digit number and a one-digit number, and adding a two-digit number and a multiple of 10.

standards.cluster: Measure lengths indirectly and by iterating length units
standards.text: Order three objects by length; compare the lengths of two objects indirectly by using a third object.

standards.cluster: Tell and write time
standards.text: Tell and write time in hours and half-hours using analog and digital clocks.

standards.cluster: Reason with shapes and their attributes
standards.text: Distinguish between defining attributes versus non-defining attributes; build and draw shapes to possess defining attributes.

standards.cluster: Represent and solve problems involving addition and subtraction
standards.text: Use addition and subtraction within 100 to solve one- and two-step word problems.

standards.cluster: Add and subtract within 20
standards.text: Fluently add and subtract within 20 using mental strategies. Know from memory all sums of two one-digit numbers.

standards.cluster: Work with equal groups of objects to gain foundations for multiplication
standards.text: Determine whether a group of objects (up to 20) has an odd or even number of members.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Understand place value
standards.text: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Use place value understanding and properties of operations to add and subtract
standards.text: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Use place value understanding and properties of operations to add and subtract
standards.text: Add and subtract within 1000, using concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value.

standards.cluster: Measure and estimate lengths in standard units
standards.text: Measure the length of an object by selecting and using appropriate tools such as rulers, yardsticks, meter sticks, and measuring tapes.

standards.cluster: Work with time and money
standards.text: Tell and write time from analog and digital clocks to the nearest five minutes, using a.m. and p.m.

standards.cluster: Work with time and money
standards.text: Solve word problems involving dollar bills, quarters, dimes, nickels, and pennies, using dollar and cent symbols appropriately.

standards.cluster: Reason with shapes and their attributes
standards.text: Recognize and draw shapes having specified attributes, such as a given number of angles or a given number of equal faces.

standards.cluster: Represent and solve problems involving multiplication and division
standards.text: Interpret products of whole numbers, e.g., interpret 5 x 7 as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7 objects each.

standards.cluster: Represent and solve problems involving multiplication and division
standards.text: Use multiplication and division within 100 to solve word problems in situations involving equal groups, arrays, and measurement quantities.

standards.cluster: Multiply and divide within 100
standards.text: Fluently multiply and divide within 100. By the end of Grade 3, know from memory all products of two one-digit numbers.

standards.cluster: Solve problems involving the four operations
standards.text: Solve two-step word problems using the four operations. Represent these problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Use place value understanding and properties of operations to perform multi-digit arithmetic
standards.text: Fluently add and subtract within 1000 using strategies and algorithms based on place value.

standards.cluster: Develop understanding of fractions as numbers
standards.text: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts.

standards.cluster: Develop understanding of fractions as numbers
standards.text: Explain equivalence of fractions in special cases, and compare fractions by reasoning about their size.

standards.cluster: Solve problems involving measurement and estimation
standards.text: Tell and write time to the nearest minute and measure time intervals in minutes.

standards.cluster: Geometric measurement: understand concepts of area
standards.text: Relate area to the operations of multiplication and addition.

standards.cluster: Reason with shapes and their attributes
standards.text: Understand that shapes in different categories may share attributes, and that the shared attributes can define a larger category.

standards.cluster: Use the four operations with whole numbers to solve problems
standards.text: Interpret a multiplication equation as a comparison. Represent verbal statements of multiplicative comparisons as multiplication equations.

standards.cluster: Gain familiarity with factors and multiples
standards.text: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1-100. Determine whether a given whole number is prime or composite.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Generalize place value understanding for multi-digit whole numbers
standards.text: Recognize that in a multi-digit whole number, a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Use place value understanding and properties of operations to perform multi-digit arithmetic
standards.text: Multiply a whole number of up to four digits by a one-digit whole number, and multiply two two-digit numbers.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Use place value understanding and properties of operations to perform multi-digit arithmetic
standards.text: Find whole-number quotients and remainders with up to four-digit dividends and one-digit divisors.

standards.cluster: Extend understanding of fraction equivalence and ordering
standards.text: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to a fraction (n x a)/(n x b) by using visual fraction models.

standards.cluster: Build fractions from unit fractions
standards.text: Understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b.

standards.cluster: Understand decimal notation for fractions, and compare decimal fractions
standards.text: Use decimal notation for fractions with denominators 10 or 100.

standards.cluster: Solve problems involving measurement and conversion of measurements
standards.text: Apply the area and perimeter formulas for rectangles in real world and mathematical problems.

standards.cluster: Draw and identify lines and angles, and classify shapes by properties of their lines and angles
standards.text: Draw points, lines, line segments, rays, angles, and perpendicular and parallel lines. Identify these in two-dimensional figures.

standards.cluster: Write and interpret numerical expressions
standards.text: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions, and evaluate expressions with these symbols.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Understand the place value system
standards.text: Recognize that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as it represents in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Perform operations with multi-digit whole numbers and with decimals to hundredths
standards.text: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.

standards.domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standards.cluster: Perform operations with multi-digit whole numbers and with decimals to hundredths
standards.text: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths, using concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value.

standards.cluster: Use equivalent fractions as a strategy to add and subtract fractions
standards.text: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions.

standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division
standards.text: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication to multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction.

standards.cluster: Geometric measurement: understand concepts of volume
standards.text: Relate volume to the operations of multiplication and addition and solve real world and mathematical problems involving volume.

standards.cluster: Graph points on the coordinate plane to solve problems
standards.text: Use a pair of perpendicular number lines, called axes, to define a coordinate system.

standards.cluster: Classify two-dimensional figures into categories based on their properties
standards.text: Understand that attributes belonging to a category of two-dimensional figures also belong to all subcategories of that category.

standards.cluster: Understand ratio concepts and use ratio reasoning to solve problems
standards.text: Understand the concept of a ratio and use ratio language to describe a ratio relationship between two quantities.

standards.cluster: Understand ratio concepts and use ratio reasoning to solve problems
standards.text: Use ratio and rate reasoning to solve real-world and mathematical problems.

standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division to divide fractions by fractions
standards.text: Interpret and compute quotients of fractions, and solve word problems involving division of fractions by fractions.

standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of numbers to the system of rational numbers
standards.text: Understand a rational number as a point on the number line. Extend number line diagrams and coordinate axes to represent points with negative number coordinates.

standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of arithmetic to algebraic expressions
standards.text: Write, read, and evaluate expressions in which letters stand for numbers.

standards.cluster: Reason about and solve one-variable equations and inequalities
standards.text: Understand solving an equation or inequality as a process of answering which values make the equation or inequality true.

standards.cluster: Reason about and solve one-variable equations and inequalities
standards.text: Solve real-world and mathematical problems by writing and solving equations of the form x + p = q and px = q.

standards.cluster: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, surface area, and volume
standards.text: Find the area of right triangles, other triangles, special quadrilaterals, and polygons by composing or decomposing into known shapes.

standards.cluster: Summarize and describe distributions
standards.text: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context.

standards.cluster: Analyze proportional relationships and use them to solve problems
standards.text: Recognize and represent proportional relationships between quantities.

standards.cluster: Analyze proportional relationships and use them to solve problems
standards.text: Use proportional relationships to solve multistep ratio and percent problems.

standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of operations with fractions
standards.text: Apply and extend previous understandings of addition and subtraction to add and subtract rational numbers.

standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of operations with fractions
standards.text: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division to multiply and divide rational numbers.

standards.cluster: Use properties of operations to generate equivalent expressions
standards.text: Apply properties of operations as strategies to add, subtract, factor, and expand linear expressions with rational coefficients.

standards.cluster: Solve real-life and mathematical problems using numerical and algebraic expressions and equations
standards.text: Use variables to represent quantities in a real-world or mathematical problem, and construct simple equations and inequalities to solve problems.

standards.cluster: Solve real-life and mathematical problems involving angle measure, area, surface area, and volume
standards.text: Know the formulas for the area and circumference of a circle and use them to solve problems.

standards.cluster: Solve real-life and mathematical problems involving angle measure, area, surface area, and volume
standards.text: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, volume and surface area of two- and three-dimensional objects.

standards.cluster: Investigate chance processes and develop, use, and evaluate probability models
standards.text: Understand that the probability of a chance event is a number between 0 and 1 that expresses the likelihood of the event occurring.

standards.cluster: Know that there are numbers that are not rational, and approximate them by rational numbers
standards.text: Know that numbers that are not rational are called irrational. Understand informally that every number has a decimal expansion.

standards.cluster: Work with radicals and integer exponents
standards.text: Know and apply the properties of integer exponents to generate equivalent numerical expressions.

standards.cluster: Understand the connections between proportional relationships, lines, and linear equations
standards.text: Graph proportional relationships, interpreting the unit rate as the slope of the graph.

standards.cluster: Analyze and solve linear equations and pairs of simultaneous linear equations
standards.text: Solve linear equations in one variable.

standards.cluster: Analyze and solve linear equations and pairs of simultaneous linear equations
standards.text: Analyze and solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations.

standards.cluster: Define, evaluate, and compare functions
standards.text: Understand that a function is a rule that assigns to each input exactly one output.

standards.cluster: Use functions to model relationships between quantities
standards.text: Construct a function to model a linear relationship between two quantities.

standards.cluster: Understand congruence and similarity using physical models, transparencies, or geometry software
standards.text: Verify experimentally the properties of rotations, reflections, and translations.

standards.cluster: Understand and apply the Pythagorean Theorem
standards.text: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem to determine unknown side lengths in right triangles in real-world and mathematical problems.

standards.cluster: Investigate patterns of association in bivariate data
standards.text: Construct and interpret scatter plots for bivariate measurement data to investigate patterns of association between two quantities.

standards.domain: Number and Quantity - The Real Number System
standards.cluster: Extend the properties of exponents to rational exponents
standards.text: Rewrite expressions involving radicals and rational exponents using the properties of exponents.

standards.cluster: Reason quantitatively and use units to solve problems
standards.text: Use units as a way to understand problems and to guide the solution of multi-step problems.

standards.cluster: Interpret the structure of expressions
standards.text: Interpret expressions that represent a quantity in terms of its context.

standards.cluster: Write expressions in equivalent forms to solve problems
standards.text: Choose and produce an equivalent form of an expression to reveal and explain properties of the quantity represented by the expression.

standards.domain: Algebra - Arithmetic with Polynomials and Rational Expressions
standards.cluster: Perform arithmetic operations on polynomials
standards.text: Understand that polynomials form a system analogous to the integers, closed under the operations of addition, subtraction, and multiplication.

standards.cluster: Create equations that describe numbers or relationships
standards.text: Create equations and inequalities in one variable and use them to solve problems.

standards.domain: Algebra - Reasoning with Equations and Inequalities
standards.cluster: Solve equations and inequalities in one variable
standards.text: Solve linear equations and inequalities in one variable, including equations with coefficients represented by letters.

standards.domain: Algebra - Reasoning with Equations and Inequalities
standards.cluster: Solve equations and inequalities in one variable
standards.text: Solve quadratic equations in one variable.

standards.domain: Algebra - Reasoning with Equations and Inequalities
standards.cluster: Solve systems of equations
standards.text: Solve systems of linear equations exactly and approximately, focusing on pairs of linear equations in two variables.

standards.cluster: Understand the concept of a function and use function notation
standards.text: Understand that a function assigns to each element of the domain exactly one element of the range.

standards.cluster: Interpret functions that arise in applications in terms of the context
standards.text: For a function that models a relationship between two quantities, interpret key features of graphs and tables in terms of the quantities.

standards.domain: Functions - Linear, Quadratic, and Exponential Models
standards.cluster: Construct and compare linear, quadratic, and exponential models
standards.text: Distinguish between situations that can be modeled with linear functions and with exponential functions.

standards.domain: Statistics and Probability - Interpreting Categorical and Quantitative Data
standards.cluster: Summarize, represent, and interpret data on two categorical and quantitative variables
standards.text: Represent data on two quantitative variables on a scatter plot, and describe how the variables are related.

standards.cluster: Experiment with transformations in the plane
standards.text: Know precise definitions of angle, circle, perpendicular line, parallel line, and line segment, based on the undefined notions of point, line, distance along a line, and distance around a circular arc.

standards.cluster: Understand congruence in terms of rigid motions
standards.text: Use geometric descriptions of rigid motions to transform figures and to predict the effect of a given rigid motion on a given figure.

standards.cluster: Prove geometric theorems
standards.text: Prove theorems about lines and angles.

standards.cluster: Prove geometric theorems
standards.text: Prove theorems about triangles.

standards.cluster: Make geometric constructions
standards.text: Make formal geometric constructions with a variety of tools and methods.

standards.domain: Geometry - Similarity, Right Triangles, and Trigonometry
standards.cluster: Understand similarity in terms of similarity transformations
standards.text: Given two figures, use the definition of similarity in terms of similarity transformations to decide if they are similar.

standards.domain: Geometry - Similarity, Right Triangles, and Trigonometry
standards.cluster: Prove theorems involving similarity
standards.text: Use congruence and similarity criteria for triangles to solve problems and to prove relationships in geometric figures.

standards.domain: Geometry - Similarity, Right Triangles, and Trigonometry
standards.cluster: Define trigonometric ratios and solve problems involving right triangles
standards.text: Use trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean Theorem to solve right triangles in applied problems.

standards.cluster: Understand and apply theorems about circles
standards.text: Identify and describe relationships among inscribed angles, radii, and chords.

standards.domain: Geometry - Expressing Geometric Properties with Equations
standards.cluster: Use coordinates to prove simple geometric theorems algebraically
standards.text: Prove the slope criteria for parallel and perpendicular lines and use them to solve geometric problems.

standards.cluster: Explain volume formulas and use them to solve problems
standards.text: Use volume formulas for cylinders, pyramids, cones, and spheres to solve problems.

standards.cluster: Apply geometric concepts in modeling situations
standards.text: Use geometric shapes, their measures, and their properties to describe objects.

standards.domain: Number and Quantity - The Complex Number System
standards.cluster: Perform arithmetic operations with complex numbers
standards.text: Know there is a complex number i such that i squared equals negative one, and every complex number has the form a + bi with a and b real.

standards.domain: Number and Quantity - The Complex Number System
standards.cluster: Use complex numbers in polynomial identities and equations
standards.text: Solve quadratic equations with real coefficients that have complex solutions.

standards.cluster: Write expressions in equivalent forms to solve problems
standards.text: Derive the formula for the sum of a finite geometric series, and use the formula to solve problems.

standards.domain: Algebra - Arithmetic with Polynomials and Rational Expressions
standards.cluster: Understand the relationship between zeros and factors of polynomials
standards.text: Know and apply the Remainder Theorem.

standards.domain: Algebra - Arithmetic with Polynomials and Rational Expressions
standards.cluster: Understand the relationship between zeros and factors of polynomials
standards.text: Identify zeros of polynomials when suitable factorizations are available, and use the zeros to construct a rough graph of the function.

standards.domain: Algebra - Arithmetic with Polynomials and Rational Expressions
standards.cluster: Rewrite rational expressions
standards.text: Rewrite simple rational expressions in different forms.

standards.domain: Algebra - Reasoning with Equations and Inequalities
standards.cluster: Understand solving equations as a process of reasoning and explain the reasoning
standards.text: Solve simple rational and radical equations in one variable, and give examples showing how extraneous solutions may arise.

standards.domain: Algebra - Reasoning with Equations and Inequalities
standards.cluster: Represent and solve equations and inequalities graphically
standards.text: Explain why the x-coordinates of the points where the graphs of two functions intersect are the solutions of the equation f(x) = g(x).

standards.cluster: Analyze functions using different representations
standards.text: Graph functions expressed symbolically and show key features of the graph, by hand in simple cases and using technology for more complicated cases.

standards.cluster: Build a function that models a relationship between two quantities
standards.text: Write a function that describes a relationship between two quantities.

standards.cluster: Build new functions from existing functions
standards.text: Find inverse functions.

standards.cluster: Extend the domain of trigonometric functions using the unit circle
standards.text: Explain how the unit circle in the coordinate plane enables the extension of trigonometric functions to all real numbers.

standards.domain: Functions - Linear, Quadratic, and Exponential Models
standards.cluster: Construct and compare linear, quadratic, and exponential models
standards.text: For exponential models, express as a logarithm the solution to an exponential equation and evaluate the logarithm using technology.

standards.domain: Statistics and Probability - Making Inferences and Justifying Conclusions
standards.cluster: Understand and evaluate random processes underlying statistical experiments
standards.text: Understand statistics as a process for making inferences about population parameters based on a random sample from that population.

standards.domain: Number and Quantity - The Complex Number System
standards.cluster: Represent complex numbers and their operations on the complex plane
standards.text: (+) Represent complex numbers on the complex plane in rectangular and polar form, and explain why the rectangular and polar forms of a given complex number represent the same number.

standards.domain: Number and Quantity - The Complex Number System
standards.cluster: Represent complex numbers and their operations on the complex plane
standards.text: (+) Represent addition, subtraction, multiplication, and conjugation of complex numbers geometrically on the complex plane.

standards.domain: Number and Quantity - Vector and Matrix Quantities
standards.cluster: Represent and model with vector quantities
standards.text: (+) Recognize vector quantities as having both magnitude and direction, and represent vector quantities by directed line segments.

standards.domain: Number and Quantity - Vector and Matrix Quantities
standards.cluster: Perform operations on vectors
standards.text: (+) Add and subtract vectors.

standards.domain: Number and Quantity - Vector and Matrix Quantities
standards.cluster: Perform operations on matrices and use matrices in applications
standards.text: (+) Use matrices to represent and manipulate data, e.g., to represent payoffs or incidence relationships in a network.

standards.domain: Algebra - Arithmetic with Polynomials and Rational Expressions
standards.cluster: Use polynomial identities to solve problems
standards.text: (+) Know and apply the Binomial Theorem for the expansion of a binomial raised to a positive integer power.

standards.cluster: Analyze functions using different representations
standards.text: (+) Graph rational functions, identifying zeros and asymptotes when suitable factorizations are available, and showing end behavior.

standards.cluster: Build new functions from existing functions
standards.text: (+) Understand the inverse relationship between exponents and logarithms and use this relationship to solve problems involving logarithms and exponents.

standards.cluster: Extend the domain of trigonometric functions using the unit circle
standards.text: (+) Use special triangles to determine geometrically the values of sine, cosine, and tangent for common angle measures.

standards.cluster: Model periodic phenomena with trigonometric functions
standards.text: (+) Understand that restricting a trigonometric function to a domain on which it is always increasing or always decreasing allows its inverse to be constructed.

standards.cluster: Prove and apply trigonometric identities
standards.text: (+) Prove the addition and subtraction formulas for sine, cosine, and tangent and use them to solve problems.

standards.domain: Geometry - Similarity, Right Triangles, and Trigonometry
standards.cluster: Apply trigonometry to general triangles
standards.text: (+) Prove the Laws of Sines and Cosines and use them to solve problems.

standards.domain: Geometry - Expressing Geometric Properties with Equations
standards.cluster: Translate between the geometric description and the equation for a conic section
standards.text: (+) Derive the equations of ellipses and hyperbolas given the foci, using the fact that the sum or difference of distances from the foci is constant.
